_comment: Input to L1-design-platform-architect, DELTA INVOCATION (BOM Phase 4), CONDITIONAL. This agent fires only when the impact assessment reports a NOT PRESENT capability against PLT-6. In most cycles it does not fire at all. It fires in Cycle 1 because the FBO register verification needs outbound third-party egress and PLT-6 has no such capability — the empty-then-large shape that is the whole reason platform is a separate document rather than a section of a per-feature HLD.

firing_condition.reason: impact-assessment.md reports 1 NOT PRESENT capability against PLT-6
firing_condition.note: Had every required capability been AVAILABLE and no topology changed, the verdict would have been PLT viewpoint = NONE and this agent would not have run. The 00-overview.md assertion table would still have carried a PLATFORM: NONE row with that reason, because gr-L1-viewpoint-completeness fails on silence, not on a stated NONE.

content.execution_summary: • 5 capabilities checked against PLT-6; 4 AVAILABLE, 1 NOT PRESENT. Platform delta required.

sections_relevant.PLT-6: 9 capability rows: 5 AVAILABLE (relational persistence, async messaging, object storage, external-party identity, secrets and key management), 3 NOT PRESENT (outbound enterprise reporting feed, full-text search, analytical plane), 1 PARTIAL (evidence-chain completeness monitoring). No row for outbound third-party egress.
sections_relevant.PLT-8: Public ingress via the group gateway; private application network; data and messaging capabilities not publicly routable. Stated for INGRESS; outbound egress is not addressed.
sections_relevant.PLT-9: One workload identity per component, 7 total, none shared. Secrets in the group vault. No application-held keys.
sections_relevant.PLT-10: Encryption at rest and in transit for PII, Financial, Regulated Evidence and Confidential; keys in the managed key capability; rotation without redeploying unrelated consumers.
sections_relevant.PLT-14: billing-service and identity-service 99.9% (ES4 regulatory defence); others 99.5%; RTO/RPO PENDING (PLT-PEND-01).
sections_relevant.PLT-15: Technology lifecycle: no contain/retire status without an approved exception. Applies to future platform deltas too.
sections_relevant.PLT-16: PLT-C1 isolation, PLT-C2 lifecycle, PLT-C3 deployability, PLT-C4 classified data protection.

nfr_classifications.boundary_condition: 99.9% for identity-service — the record could be required for active regulatory defence
The credential used to call the competent authority's register is a secret and must be vault-managed

integration_delta_ref.flow: INT-4.7 identity-service -> competent-authority FBO register, outbound, request/response at the boundary, consumed out of band
integration_delta_ref.degraded_mode: NoAnswer leaves the registration pending with bounded retry; no branch treats an unanswered lookup as valid
integration_delta_ref.correlation_rule: The producer's session correlation id is NOT propagated across this boundary
